dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Nothing special, really. I could have come directly to Sumeru from Fontaine... after all, there's a line going straight to the Bayda Harbor in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: But to make the trip a bit more interesting, I went to Liyue via Lumidouce Harbor and Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: After that, I took a ferry to Port Ormos from Liyue Harbor. Then I traveled northwards along the river, and here I am.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: When I return, I may trek across the desert, and return via Romaritime Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: ...However, I have plenty of Mora left, so crossing the desert to Natlan sounds nice, too...
